    Translation quivers and scalar mesh categories #

    Definitions 2.3 and 2.4 of the source paper.

    • The k-linear path category of a quiver is Free k (Paths Q): morphisms x ⟶ y are finite linear combinations of paths from x to y, and p ≫ q is the path p followed by q. This matches the source paper's left-to-right path products.
    • A quotient of the path category by the two-sided ideal linearly generated by a family of relations is RelationCategory.
    • A translation quiver carries a bijection τ from the nonprojective onto the noninjective vertices, and mates σ a : τ x ⟶ y for every arrow a : y ⟶ x with x nonprojective. The mate bijection is recorded separately for each pair (x, y); this is the same as one bijection from the arrows ending at nonprojective vertices onto the arrows starting at noninjective vertices with the stated endpoints.
    • The scalar mesh category C(Q,c) is the quotient by the mesh relations r_x = ∑_{a : y → x} c_{x,a} (σ a) a.
